items.name: Funded backlog, quarter ended June 28 2026
items.claim: Teledyne ended the quarter with approximately $5.0 billion of funded backlog, as sales and non-GAAP earnings increased 9.8% and 20.8% respectively; Digital Imaging organic growth was led by infrared detectors and systems for space, airborne and marine unmanned systems, including counter unmanned applications.
items.source_excerpt: Sales and non-GAAP earnings increased 9.8% and 20.8%, respectively, and we ended the quarter with approximately $5.0 billion of funded backlog. Organic growth was greatest in our Digital Imaging segment, where infrared detectors and systems for space and airborne and marine unmanned systems, as well as counter unmanned applications, each increased considerably.

notes: Sourced from the stored Q2 2026 8-K earnings release (data/edgar/docs/TDY.json). Teledyne's own release names counter-unmanned applications as a growth driver within Digital Imaging, directly relevant to the munitions-replenishment chain's sensor/detection links; no segment-level backlog breakout is disclosed at this level of detail.
